description: This source file implements service registration, loading, and management functionalities for an embedded system or device, interacting with JSON configurations, UBUS, and service objects.

methods.name: void add_service_to_list(const char * name,int service_proto,service_object_t * objects,size_t count,bool is_unified)
methods.description: Adds a new service entry to the global linked list of registered services.

methods.name: int load_service_from_file(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx,const char * filename,const char * file_path)
methods.description: Loads a service configuration from a JSON file, parses the objects, and registers the service.

methods.name: int filter(const struct dirent * entry)
methods.description: Filters directory entries, excluding hidden files (those starting with '.').

methods.name: int compare(const struct dirent ** a,const struct dirent ** b)
methods.description: Compares directory entries for sorting, first by length then alphabetically.

methods.name: int register_services(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx)
methods.description: Scans the input directory for service files and loads each service.

methods.name: void unregister_services(void)
methods.description: Removes all registered services from the list and deallocates associated memory.

methods.name: void list_registered_services(struct blob_buf * bb)
methods.description: Outputs registered services and their objects in a blob buffer, for external querying.

methods.name: bool is_path_match(const char * requested_path,unsigned int requested_proto,service_entry_t * service)
methods.description: Checks if a requested path and protocol match a service's objects.

methods.name: char * get_ubus_object_name(const char * path)
methods.description: Finds the service name associated with a given path.

methods.name: void reference_data_callback(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Callback invoked to process the response from a UBUS invocation, extracting reference data.

methods.name: char * get_reference_data(const char * path,const char * method_name)
methods.description: Retrieves reference data from a specified path and method via UBUS call.
